data.text: ## Effects Defines what effects should be attached to button elements within the interface. **** should be the name of the element. There are additional modifiers added before the **click** suffix that alter the type of click recognized. These are fairly obvious to understand, and can be chained. Modifiers: - right - alt - control - shift For example: `my_button_alt_right_click = { }`
